body:
# PULL REQUEST

## Purpose and Content
We want to compare our simulations with PySDM simulations. In PySDM simulations prognostic variables are density of the dry air, rho_dry, and temperature T. This pull request makes these variables prognostic. The liquid ice potential temperature,  theta_liq_ice, and density of moist air, rho, which were previously prognostic variables are now derived.

## Benefits and Risks
With the new change of the code, temperature profiles remain constant and below what they were in previous simulations. Consequently, we get more liquid and rain. The new results compare better with PySDM simulations. As a result calibration of microphysics parameters with PySDM data can be done meaningfully.
